domain_conditions: N is an integer and N >= 3

admissibility_conditions: weak voters use as-if-pivotal expected-value comparison
T^Y selects yes at expected-value equality
weak proposals and votes do not move beliefs about theta
the proposer first maximizes own payoff and then minimizes expected H payoff
equilibrium_records.branch_classification: complete majority correspondence over exclusion, low-type screening with high-type delay, and pooling; deliberate rejection and on-path slack excluded

hegemon_vote.at_least_q_minus_1_weak_yes: no for both types; proposal passes without H
hegemon_vote.exactly_q_minus_2_weak_yes: type theta votes yes iff y>=t_theta
hegemon_vote.at_most_q_minus_3_weak_yes: yes for both types by T^Y; proposal still fails

candidate_families.exclusion: choose q-1 responders, pay each w, set y=0 and retain E
candidate_families.screening: choose q-2 responders, pay each w, set y=t_0 and retain L when feasible
candidate_families.pooling: choose q-2 responders, pay each w, set y=t_1 and retain P when feasible

strategy_profile.atomic_family_binder: All strategy, payoff, and outcome fields in this record use the same identity-indexed family F=(F_i)_{i in W}, with each F_i supported on the feasible lexicographic argmax A_i_star(nu).

outcome_indicators.I_H(s,theta): one iff proposal s passes with H for type theta
outcome_indicators.I_X(s,theta): one iff proposal s passes without H for type theta
outcome_indicators.I_D(s,theta): one iff proposal s fails in R1 and reaches N1 for type theta

strategy_profile.selection: for each proposer identity, any distribution supported on the feasible lexicographic argmax of {E,S(nu),P}; coalition-identity multiplicity is preserved

frontiers.pooling_exclusion_tie: o_1=1/m; above screening, compare expected H payoffs h_E and h_P

belief_system.after_weak_votes: unchanged from the belief before the ballot
belief_system.after_prescribed_H_vote: Bayes using H's type-contingent strategy whenever the denominator is positive; weak-vote factors cancel
belief_system.zero_total_probability_H_action: support-restricted: posterior zero throughout the tree at nu=0 and one throughout the tree at nu=1; when 0<nu<1, an out-of-profile H action may induce any posterior in [0,1]
belief_system.after_H_action_outside_profile: free in [0,1] only for 0<nu<1; fixed at zero when nu=0 and at one when nu=1
belief_system.continuation_effect: all resulting beliefs consume posterior-invariant N1-EQ-01

equilibrium_records.existence_uniqueness_status: exists for every admissible primitive and nu; generally strategy-multiple through coalition identities and the residual exclusion-pooling tie
equilibrium_records.selection_status: all lexicographically optimal proposer distributions preserved; no symmetry, belief, or equilibrium selection added
assumptions_used: fixed unit pie and full implementation
new solution-concept package of 2026-08-21 plus the subsequent endpoint support restriction
checks_performed: belief transport under no-signaling and endpoint support restriction
strict exclusion gain over deliberate rejection
atomic binding of every payoff and outcome to the same F=(F_i)_i
equilibrium_records.recognized_proposer_payoff: For every recognized i, E_{s~F_i,theta~nu}[r_i(s)*(I_H(s,theta)+I_X(s,theta))+w*I_D(s,theta)]=V_star(nu)=max{E,S(nu),P} after feasibility and the authorized tie-break; the same F_i is used in every field.

weak_nonproposer_pre_recognition_expecte.atomic_family: the same F=(F_i)_i used by strategy_profile, H payoffs, and outcomes
weak_nonproposer_pre_recognition_expecte.recognition_accounting: the first term is l's probability 1/m of being proposer; each term in the sum is probability 1/m that another identity i proposes

equilibrium_records.payoff_date: R1 current units; N1 values multiplied by beta exactly once
